title: Penguin Panic now available in the Epic Game Store
body:
Penguin Panic, is now available in the Epic Game Store for PC and Mac! This pure penguin-powered fun game for all ages, now even more EPIC.

 

Epic Features

Penguin Panic in the Epic store of course has it all. It contains Achievements, Leaderboards and Cloud Saves, so that you can continue your quest across different machines.

 

The Game

The walruses stole your eggs. Time to get them back! Run, jump, and stomp your way through 17 vibrant levels in this fast-paced, family-friendly platformer. Battle bad guys, uncover secrets, and collect shiny fish—all with simple controls and tons of charm.

 

Download

Go get Penguin Panic in the Epic Game Store now!
